risks.risk: The machine may have internal faults or not power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on with the digital display active and performing a test weld.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the TIG torch, electrode holder, and earth clamp may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included cables, torches, and accessories.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare unit without accessories

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock or third-party image rather than the actual unit for sale.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with a handwritten note showing the current date and seller's name.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and welding in both TIG and MMA modes.
Photo of all included accessories (torches, leads, clamps).
Photo of the technical specification plate on the back or side of the machine.
Photo of the machine with a handwritten note of today's date to verify possession.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photo. While functional status and included accessories are unverified, the item can be priced at its worst-case scenario as a non-functional bare unit.
